messages:
jonas: Heads-up — canary rollout for ranker-v2 is showing metric flips vs baseline on the rollouts dashboard. Looks like spikes in response_latency.p50 and drop in ctr. Might be attribution problem. Pinging eng-platform. :eyes:

nina: Can you share dashboard link + the rollout id? Also point me to the request -> metric mapping you used.

jonas: rollout id `rl_2026_09_ranker_v2` dashboard https://console.redwood/rollouts/rl_2026_09_ranker_v2
The baseline is rl_2026_08. Both traffic splits 5%->95% initial.

sam: deploy-bot logged the canary at 11:02 UTC earlier, no errors. But our telemetry shows some requests missing `split_id` and `route_tags`. Suspect router shard dropping headers under load.

deploy-bot: deploy event: rl_2026_09_ranker_v2 promoted to canary 2026-09-15T11:02:12Z by @release-engineering

maya: If split attribution is missing, the dashboard's aggregation might be mixing baseline and canary buckets. We should treat missing split as 'unknown' not 'baseline' in the UI.

leo: Agree. Also propose adding precomputed per-rollout deltas in the metrics API to avoid client-side joins. That would reduce noise when there's partial telemetry.

nina: How about adding `split_id` to our span/telemetry spec? Example event:
```json
{
 "request_id": "r_123",
 "model": "ranker-v2",
 "split_id": "rl_2026_09_ranker_v2:canary",
 "route_policy": "latency-pref",
 "latency_ms": 42
}
```
Would that be acceptable?

sam: Works but we need to be careful w/ quotas. Adding fields increases event size and could push costs up on high-throughput paths. Maybe send a compact numeric split tag instead of full string.

jonas: Good point — maybe `split_id` numeric referencing a rollout table (index). Router would stamp index. sdk/agents can resolve to name in console.

maya: Also need to keep privacy: no customer PII in tags. We already PII-scrub request path, just flagging for review.

leo: UI changes: add 'Unknown split' breakdown in drawer and a toggle 'exclude unknowns' that recomputes baselines. Also wire an alert for 'unknown split > 1% of traffic' to reduce silent attribution regressions.

nina: Alert params? sensitivity needs to avoid noise. Maybe threshold 1% absolute or 10% relative delta for 3 consecutive mins? Thoughts.

jonas: Proposal: fire when unknown_split_ratio > 0.01 AND unknown_traffic_change > 0.005 over 5m. Devex can tune. I'll open a PR for telemetry spec + rollout-indexing.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll prototype stamping index in router this afternoon. If router patch touches quotas, will flag.

deploy-bot: note: canary rollback option available if alert triggers. Run `/canary rollback rl_2026_09_ranker_v2`

maya: I'll run a quick eval job to see if the CTR drop is real on raw logs vs pre-aggregates. ETA 2 hours.

nina: I'll prep UI mockups for unknown-split drawer and alert config. Ping me if you want to collab.

jonas: Thanks all. Action items: jonas PR telemetry spec, sam router index prototype, nina UI mocks, maya raw-eval. Recheck in 6h or earlier if alerts hit. :rocket:
